title: Postal traffic into US plunges by more than 80% after Trump ends exemption
summary: Dozens of operators have suspended service to the US until a solution is implemented on parcels worth $800 or less Postal traffic into the United States plunged by more than 80% after the Trump administration ended a tariff exemption for low-cost imports, the United Nations postal agency said Saturday. The Universal Postal Union says it has started rolling out new measures that can help postal operators around the world calculate and collect duties, or taxes, after the US eliminated the so-called “de minimis exemption” for lower-value parcels.
